newsitem.title: THAILAND: Cambodia airport closed - airline source.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia airport closed - airline source.

text.p: The airport in Cambodia's capital city was closed on Saturday and at least one flight was forced to return to Bangkok, a Thai Airways employee said.

A Thai Airways ticket agent told Reuters all flights for the rest of the day had been cancelled to Phnom Penh and the morning flight from Bangkok was told to return to Thailand because the airport was closed.

"The rest of the flights for today are cancelled," the Thai Airways agent said. "This morning's flight was told to return to Bangkok when it arrived there." A Reuters cameraman on Flight TG696 on Saturday morning confirmed the plane had almost arrived in Phnom Penh when it was told to return to Bangkok.
When asked why landing had been refused, the ticket agent said it was for political reasons.

Troops loyal to Cambodia's rival prime ministers, who head a fractured coalition government, clashed on the northwestern outskirts of Phnom Penh earlier on Saturday as soldiers loyal to Prime Minister Hun Sen approached a base controlled by royalist Co-Prime Minister Norodom Ranariddh's men.
